description: Apply Warren Buffett's investment framework as a discipline lens when weighing a buy, hold, or sell decision — circle of competence, economic moat, owner earnings & intrinsic value, margin of safety, management/capital-allocation quality, and market psychology (Mr. Market, fear vs greed, temperament). Use when asked to "run this through Buffett", "what would Buffett say", "does this pass the moat test", "is this cheap enough", or for a second, more skeptical read on a name being evaluated or already held. This is a discipline overlay, not a replacement for a strategy — it applies the Buffett lens to how someone actually invests, rather than issuing generic advice.
